sources.quote: The acquisition of Reebok also allowed Adidas to compete with Nike worldwide as the number two athletic shoemaker in the world.

sources.note: Approximate count (AND within a window, max_clause_freq 500000).

sources.quote: It was founded in 1869 and is headquartered in the Battery Park City neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City, with offices in many financial centers worldwide.

notes: Dev RBox revision: flips the symmetry of competes_with to asymmetry. competes_with follows from no other tag, so there is no route back to the property. The instances are true and famous (Coca-Cola and PepsiCo; Adidas and Nike). Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the direct question asks 'asymmetric' (no, then yes), the first instance asks the converse (yes, then no), the second asks whether the fact rules out the converse (no, then yes); the cross-lingual queries are the first instance. Near unrelated asks the same property of merged_with. hops counts the instance fact as the bridge.
